text:
carla (marketing): Heads up team  reworking the competitor battlecard for the Q3 roadshow. Want this focused on three things: predictable latency, cost delta at scale, and rollout safety (fallbacks). Draft attached: https://redwood-internal/drive/battlecard-q3-draft
rita (research): skimmed the draft. please don't lead with absolute % savings. show ranges and include a short methods line: 'tests run on commit abc123, 1k warmup tokens, p50/p95 averaged across 10 runs.'
noah (product): adding a short tech bullet about routing/fallbacks: "Automatic fallback to quantized model variants and cross-region spillover keeps SLAs during surge." That helps vs provider endpoints which often drop to best-effort.
ben (growth): CTA & routing suggestions: make the primary CTA "See interactive bench" and add a secondary CTA "Talk to an ops engineer". Inbound rule idea: add 'interest=ops-bench' to route to SdrOps and 'interest=enterprise' to AE queue. Also add UTM proposal: utm_source=roadshow&utm_campaign=q3_battlecard
toni (sales): can we get three one-liners per objection? copy samples below for SDRs:
- "If predictable latency is the blocker, we offer Dedicated pools with p95 guarantees and fallbacks to keep your app live."
- "If cost is the blocker, our Optimize tooling finds batching/quantization levers that cut unit cost without replatforming."
- "If compliance is the blocker, Private deployment + KMS is available."
rita (research): short snack copy recommendations for slides (very short):
- "Deterministic latency. Real cost savings."
- "Fallbacks > silent failures."
- "Optimize for tokens, not just ops."
carla (marketing): Ben, want to A/B test hero lines on the signup modal. Your picks?
ben (growth): A: "Inference you can budget for." B: "Cut per-token cost without losing quality." also suggest two email preview lines: "Who wins at production latency?" and "How teams shave inference spend"
noah (product): Add a tiny reproducibility snippet to the battlecard footnote so engineers can run a quick sanity check. Example: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"open-llm-x","input":"hello","max_tokens":64}'
```
toni (sales): Also request a lead-triage field 'deploy_priority = dev | pilot | enterprise' so SDRs can prioritize. And please include a short procurement rebut: "Reserved capacity + visibility into unit economics during pilot reduces procurement friction."
carla (marketing): legal check needed for "beats" language and any direct comparisons to named cloud vendors. @legal-bot can you run a quick scan?
legal-bot: quick-check: avoid absolute statements like "beats X". Recommend phrasing: "shows lower median latency in our benchmarks" and keep model names generic unless permission granted.
carla (marketing): thanks. final gating: (1) research to add methods line, (2) product to approve fallback wording, (3) sales to confirm SDR snippets and triage fields. Can we close by 18:00 PT?
rita (research): will drop methods line and ranges by 16:30 PT.
noah (product): approving fallback wording with a tiny tweak  changed 'keeps SLAs' to 'helps meet latency targets under load.'
toni (sales): confirming SDR snippets + triage fields by 17:30 PT; will upload to Outreach.
ben (growth): will set up A/B test in GA and ensure UTMs are on every link.
deploy-bot: queued: roadshow battlecard live 2025-08-01T12:00:00Z; webinar signups begin 2025-07-28T09:00:00Z; social posts scheduled 2025-08-01T13:00:00Z.
carla (marketing): awesome. I'll publish the updated battlecard after approvals. leaving this thread open for any last-minute copy edits. :rocket:
